MR BRAIN: 11/05/23

CLINICAL HISTORY: Recurrent anaplastic ependymoma.

COMPARISON: 07/15/23 and 04/20/23

TECHNIQUE: MR imaging of the brain performed on a 3 Tesla magnet system utilizing the following pulse sequences: Three plane localizer, axial T1, axial and coronal T1 postgadolinium, axial and coronal FLAIR, axial diffusion.

FINDINGS:

The examination shows stable findings compared to 07/15/23. A periventricular mass in the left lateral ventricle is present, measuring approximately 3.1 cm in its greatest dimension. The mass demonstrates heterogeneous enhancement and is associated with mild surrounding edema. Ventricular size is stable with no significant hydrocephalus. Basilar leptomeningeal enhancement is noted, consistent with previous imaging. No new areas of restricted diffusion are observed.

IMPRESSION:

1. Stable appearance of the periventricular mass in the left lateral ventricle, consistent with known anaplastic ependymoma.

2. No evidence of new or progressive disease. Stable leptomeningeal enhancement.

END OF IMPRESSION:
